resources.string: This app shows the Locuvi you already run: on your computer (with \"Let my phone and tablet connect\" switched on) or on your own server.\n\nEnter its address. You\'ll find it in Locuvi under Settings › Phones, tablets and computers.
Enter the address of your Locuvi.
Couldn\'t reach Locuvi at %1$s. Check that Locuvi is running and that this phone is on the same network (or on Tailscale), then tap Connect again.
